Summarize Checks

Summarize checks using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

summarize_checks(checks)

Example input

{
  "checks": [
    {
      "name": "lint",
      "status": "PASS"
    },
    {
      "name": "integration",
      "status": "FAIL"
    }
  ]
}

Example output

{
  "PASS": [
    "lint"
  ],
  "FAIL": [
    "integration"
  ],
  "BLOCKED": [],
  "UNKNOWN": []
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py summarize_checks < examples/summarize-checks.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
